name: Goldfish
description: For many low-resource languages, the only available language models are large multilingual models trained on many languages simultaneously. Despite state-of-the-art performance on reasoning tasks, we find that these models still struggle with basic grammatical text generation in many languages. First, large multilingual models perform worse than bigrams for many languages (e.g. 24% of languages in XGLM 4.5B; 43% in BLOOM 7.1B) using FLORES perplexity as an evaluation metric.
